lines.lyric_hangul: 나란히 길을 걸어 마지막이 될 줄도 모르고 난
lines.lyric_translation: Walking side by side, / Not even knowing that this would be our last time,

lines.lyric_hangul: 남겨진 발자국에서 네 향기가 남았는지 돌아봐
lines.lyric_translation: I look back to see if your scent remains / In the footprints you left behind
Our story was beautiful
Please don’t forget that you mean more to me

lines.lyric: Geu isange uimiran geol itji mara jweo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 이상의 의미란 걸 잊지 말아 줘
lines.lyric_translation: Than the memories you left behind

lines.lyric: Gin haru sogeul hemaeida dashi shijakdweneun bam
lines.lyric_hangul: 긴 하루 속을 헤매이다 다시 시작되는 밤
lines.lyric_translation: After wandering through a long day, night begins again
There’s still so many things I haven’t said
So that I’m not hurting in my dreams,
I want to softly call out to you

lines.lyric_hangul: 다 잊지 못해 바라는 순간 예전처럼 돌아가게 될까
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t forget everything; as soon as I wish for it, / Will things go back to the way they were?

lines.lyric_hangul: 한마디에 바뀔 걸 알아 전하지 못한 말
lines.lyric_translation: I know that just one word would change it, / The words I couldn’t tell you

lines.lyric: Gipeun kkum sok nareul gadweo bonaeji ma
lines.lyric_hangul: 깊은 꿈 속 나를 가둬 보내지 마
lines.lyric_translation: Lock me inside a deep dream, don’t make me leave
I didn’t remember, I thought I’d forgotten
That singular piece of your memory

lines.lyric: Geuriul ttaemyeon han beonsshik kkeonaeeo bolge
lines.lyric_hangul: 그리울 때면 한 번씩 꺼내어 볼게
lines.lyric_translation: Whenever I miss you, I’ll look back on it

lines.lyric: Naege boyeojudeon naman bol su itteon neoye moseup
lines.lyric_hangul: 내게 보여주던 나만 볼 수 있던 너의 모습
lines.lyric_translation: The side of you that you showed me, that only I could see

lines.lyric: Han beonjjeumeun neodo nareul tteoollyeo jullae
lines.lyric_hangul: 한 번쯤은 너도 나를 떠올려 줄래
lines.lyric_translation: At least once, will you think of me too?
Our story was beautiful
Please don’t forget that you mean more to me

lines.lyric_translation: Lock me inside a deep dream, don’t make me leave
So that I’m not hurting in that dream,
I’ll try to softly call out to you
I can’t forget everything; as soon as I wish for it,
Will we go back to the way we were?

lines.lyric_translation: I know that just one word would change it, / The words I couldn’t tell you
